tool.name: sincei scCombineCounts
tool.description: merge count matrices of several samples or modalities
tool.command: #import re #set $labels = [] #set $seen_labels = set() #for $i, $h5ad in enumerate($inputs) ln -s '$h5ad' 'input_${i}.h5ad' && ## sanitize the dataset name; labels that collide afterwards get a numeric suffix, ## otherwise sincei's multi-modal mode silently drops all but one of them #set $base_label = re.sub(r'[^\w\-.]', '_', re.sub(r'\.h5ad$', '', str($h5ad.element_identifier))) #set $label = $base_label #set $n = 2 #while $label in $seen_labels #set $label = '%s_%d' % ($base_label, $n) #set $n += 1 #end while #silent $seen_labels.add($label) #silent $labels.append("'%s'" % $label) #end for scCombineCounts --input #for $i, $h5ad in enumerate($inputs) 'input_${i}.h5ad' #end for --labels #echo ' '.join($labels)# --method '$method' #if str($method) == 'multi-sample': --outFile combined.h5ad #else: --outFile combined.h5mu #end if #if str($method) == 'multi-sample': && mv combined.h5ad '$combined_h5ad' #else: && mv combined.h5mu '$combined_h5mu' #end if

param.name: inputs
param.label: Count matrices (AnnData)
param.help: Two or more AnnData (h5ad) objects from sincei. The dataset names are used as sample (or modality) labels.

param.label: Method
param.help: How to merge the counts from the provided samples.
param.option: multi-sample: each sample is independent, but counted in the same manner (on the same features); looks for feature overlaps, not barcode overlaps
multi-modal: counts generated in different ways from the same set of cells (e.g. a multi-omic assay); looks for barcode overlaps, not feature overlaps

tool.help:
**What it does**
`scCombineCounts` merges several count matrices produced by `scCountReads` into one.
- **multi-sample**: the inputs are independent samples counted on the same features (e.g. the same bins). Features are matched between inputs and cells are concatenated. The result is an AnnData (`h5ad`) object usable by all sincei tools. Only features present in all inputs are kept. - **multi-modal**: the inputs are different measurements (e.g. RNA and ATAC) of the same cells. Cells are matched between inputs. The result is a MuData (`h5mu`) object.
No batch-effect correction or integration is performed.
-----
**Inputs**
- Two or more AnnData (`h5ad`) count matrices. The dataset names are used as sample (or modality) labels. Characters other than letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.` are replaced by `_`. If two names end up identical, the later ones get a numeric suffix (`_2`, `_3`).
**Outputs**
- A combined AnnData (`h5ad`) or MuData (`h5mu`) object. @HELP_FOOTER@
